title: Production of natural zeolite-filled recycled PVDF filters and their application for gray water treatment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW01070A, Paper
Ayşenur Katırcı, Seniyecan Kahraman, Filiz Uğur Nigiz
In this study, clinoptilolite (Clp)-doped poly(vinylidene fluoride) (PVDF) membranes (1–4 wt%) were prepared using an electrospinning method.
